retrieval.scope: Photo-level union of retrieved candidates. Multi-photo identity-to-box retrieval is unscored.

detection.scope: Count deficit against source identities, using the detection record when supplied. Missing crop results are reported separately. Correct localisation and duplicate detections require separate box review.

verification.exclusion_reason: Photos with multiple detected or source-labelled products lack source-backed identity for every object. Candidate verification excludes these photos, including P059.
verification.scope: Only supplied, actually checked candidate-photo pairs on single-object photos. Unchecked candidates are excluded; incomplete instance coverage cannot establish contradiction.
